messages:
emily: Quick prod clearance check — can we confirm SLA tiers, docs signoff, support rota, monitoring alerts, and final pricing for tomorrow's release? cc @ops @docs

sam: Can you drop a concise checklist? I can own SLA wording and SLO numbers.

kevin: I'll validate runbooks and escalation matrix. Need expected QPS and burst profile to size paging.

lena: Docs team: user guide + rollout notes need final review. If content is frozen I can ship by EOD.

emily: Proposed SLA seeds: Hosted Standard: p99 < 150ms; Dedicated: 99.9% availability SLA. Thoughts?

sam: 150ms p99 is aggressive for longer sequences / r2 models. Suggest p99 < 250ms for requests >1k tokens, or model-profile caveat. :thinking_face:

emily: Okay add model-profile caveat and seq-length buckets. Also pricing — we have tiered usage + reserved capacity discounts, finance to finalize numbers.

micah: Finance here — pricing doc in Drive: shortlink/pri-sheet. Draft discounts: 20% for 6mo commit @50k tokens/day, 30% for 12mo. Can adjust with usage bands.

kevin: Oncall: rotation ready but need explicit escalation to ML-runtime team + SRE 2nd line. I'll add a matrix to runbook and link.

lena: Monitoring: dashboards needed for latency (p50/p95/p99), error-rate, model fallback counts, and cost-per-call. Proposed alerts: error-rate >1% for 5m, p95 latency >300ms for 10m, fallback rate >0.5% 5m.

sam: Add regression detection: golden prompts + daily canary evals via Redwood Optimize. Alert if quality drop >threshold.

emily: Docs + runbooks — who signs off? Need explicit owners and a signoff timestamp.

lena: I'll coordinate reviewers. Plan: docs review complete and sign-off by 18:00 PST (emily, kevin, product reviewer).

micah: Pricing approval blockers: expected commit numbers and first-month usage forecast. EMs please confirm numbers by noon.

jess: I can provide traffic forecast for week 0 and week 4, include percentiles and peak windows.

emily: Action items: sam — finalize SLA text + model caveats; kevin — runbooks + escalation matrix; lena — docs + dashboards + signoff; micah — finalize pricing sheet; jess — traffic forecast. Reconvene at 17:30 UTC to close.

oncall-bot: Reminder: deploy freeze in 1h for release window. :warning:

emily: Thanks — if anyone can't hit their item call it out now. :thumbsup:
